description:
Cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for developers, sysadmins, and homelabs.

ZestSSH is a cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. It brings a tabbed desktop shell with split panes, jump-host chaining, port forwarding, an SFTP file browser, snippets and workflows, live server monitoring, and optional end-to-end encrypted sync across every device, all backed by a single shared connection library.
ZestSSH 3.2.5: a welcome on first launch (sign in, create an account, or continue without one); Join a team and Create a team let you sign in right there and keep your invite code; the team's Members page shows who is waiting for you at the top; Upgrade and Sign in have buttons of their own at the bottom left. Switch to session works again on the Hosts page.
